_provenance: HARD-CODED ON PURPOSE. Every value here was computed OUTSIDE this repository
by a different implementation, so that a pi-mesh client and a pi-mesh server
agreeing with each other cannot make a test pass. Two implementations sharing
one mistaken reading of the transcript would produce identical wrong bytes.
rfc4231[]: transcribed from RFC 4231 section 4 (published standard).
everything else: computed with Python's hmac/hashlib and independently
re-computed with `openssl dgst -sha256 -mac HMAC`; both agree. The RFC
vectors anchor the primitive, the others anchor the transcript layout.
DO NOT regenerate these from the implementation under test. If a value
here is wrong, fix it from an external implementation, not from ours.

swarmKey._note: 32 raw bytes, base64-encoded, exactly as it appears on disk in ~/.pi-mesh/swarm.key

handshake._note: transcript order is clientNonce, serverNonce, clientPeerId, serverPeerId, NUL-joined
handshake._naiveJoin: plain concatenation of the four fields with NO separator; must NOT equal hmacBase64, otherwise the NUL separator is not really being applied

requestProof._note: transcript order is method, path, sha256(body) hex, peer, nonce, timestamp, NUL-joined
a bodyless request: sha256 of the EMPTY string, not of the string "undefined" or of nothing at all
